en: A vintage black‑and‑white view of a small railway station. On the right stands a two‑storey station building with arched ground‑floor openings and a signboard on the wall. Railway tracks run through the center of the image, with a simple covered platform and bench on the left and trees in the background. The scene is quiet and appears rural or small‑town. The photograph has the look of an early 20th‑century postcard.
